Taos, NM10 contributions

Tiny Portions Big Prices
Jan 2021
I know Mexican food. This is ok/average Mexican food. The chicken tacos were passable until they melted a ton of cheese on the top making them into a casserole. It is pricy for HaNoi....heck, $4 for a taco in the US is expensive too. If that is not bad enough, the portions are tiny. High prices + small portions: for example, shrimp taco main dish (around $9) comes with two shrimp tacos and ...noting else...no rice, no beans....I do not know how this place stays in business. There are so many better options in HaNoi. The atmosphere gets an A and the staff is fantastic and sincere.

reviews.review_text:
Abigail R
8 contributions

Overpriced and tried to scam us
Jan 2019 • Couples
They tried to scam us. The manager comes round and offers you tapas, olives etc. They don't mention it costs money, and tapas is usually free yet for a small bowl of olives they wanted 80,000d. Obviously very misleading but I guess we were fools to expect anything complimentary in Vietnam. The worst, however, was that when we complained about this the manager said she would remove it from the bill. Great, we thought. However they then short changed us for 75000d so were obviously trying to charge us anyway! The waitresses wouldnt meet my eye when I tried to call them over and instead the manager marched back over and said yes yes another hundred I know. So, you knew you were trying to scam me then? You knew you were giving me the wrong change.

I dont think we would have mentoioned the olives if it wasn't for the tiny portions and how expensive it was, 150,000d for a tiny plate of nachos! Like 10 chips and only salsa and cheese. Our bill was over 800,000d which is so expensive for the quality and portion. I wouldn't recommend this place, there are far better Mexicans in the old town that are run by honest people.

hannostamm
Siem Reap, Cambodia1028 contributions

Not Mexican, Latin food
Jan 2018 • Solo
Just to clear that up as I see many comments here about Mexican food. The food is Latin, and as such is very good. I had the ham and Chorizo as a starter. Not cheap but that was expected as the cold cuts are imported. The ham regrettably was straight out of the freezer and still had pieces of ice stuck to it.

The main course, chicken with black rice was pretty good though it could have used a little more seasoning.

Whilst I am no big fan of getting my menu on an IPdad, service was outstanding.
